changelog: Whispering Valley v1.5.2: 8 cozy mixed-gender characters with unique playstyle buffs, polished EarthBound rolling HP, indoor roof chimney smoke & outdoor rain campfire sizzle, mobile Dash button & radial polish, open-water fishing with Glowworm Bait & Magnet Lure, reactive hostile/harmless mob AI + 10 new biome creatures, species-authentic animal care, and tightened 4.0-tile reach.
